snippet.title: Teaser Trailer- A Villainess game on Steam, 'Your Crown is Mine'
snippet.description:
I couldn't find my dream game, so I made it on my own as a solo dev!
❤️WISHLIST "Your Crown Is Mine" on Steam now❤️

🌟 Game description:
Take the throne and fix the corrupt kingdom— or worsen it! A villainess life sim and visual novel where you balance your stats and romance rival nations' leaders for foreign policy purposes. How will you rule the country? The game includes hundreds of hand-drawn artworks by me.

🌟 You may like this game if...
you enjoy villainess (otome isekai) manhwa, fantasy political drama, or 'raise a princess' games. There are also optional romance routes. I was inspired by games like Volcano Princess and Princess Maker.

Want more info about the game? Check the Steam page of "Your Crown Is Mine".

🌟 Credits:
Everything in the trailer and game are made by me (@Lyyycaena )
Music: "Trailer Theme" by me

🌟 Contact me -- Enquiries & constructive feedback are welcome
Email: Lyyycaena@gmail.com 
Socials: on channel page
